critique.evidence: The oversized editorial headline, neon threat palette, and cyan kill-chain path above a stage-organized attack taxonomy create a recognizable “adversary atlas” concept. However, much of the main body still reads as familiar dark-dashboard tabs, card columns, badges, and a JSON inspector. On tablet and especially mobile, the signature chain and taxonomy are visibly clipped into narrow fragments, so the distinctive visual idea loses demo impact rather than becoming a memorable responsive composition.
critique.fix: Turn the kill chain into the unmistakable centerpiece: let selecting a vector illuminate its complete route through the chain and connect visually to the detail panel. Replace clipped mobile columns with a deliberate stage-by-stage horizontal atlas or focused single-stage view, while reducing the generic JSON-panel prominence.
